What does a working day look like as a Concrete Worker? You start at 6 a.m. and finish at 2:30 p.m., together with your team. As a Concrete Worker, your tasks are varied and concrete:

 
• You help produce precast concrete elements.
 
• You burn off cables following clear instructions.
 
• You occasionally operate the overhead crane.
 
• You carry out pressure tests to check quality.
 
• You support colleagues where needed and keep your workplace tidy.

 As a Concrete Worker, you work closely with fellow workers and a team supervisor. Teamwork is key, and you can always rely on guidance on the floor.

What do we expect from you as a Concrete Worker?

Must-haves

 
• You can work in a fixed schedule from 6:00 to 14:30.
 
• You have a good knowledge of English or Dutch to follow instructions.
 
• You are willing to step in where needed and learn different tasks.
 
• You can work both independently and in a team.
 
• You work safely and in an orderly way.

Nice-to-haves

 
• Experience with concrete or an overhead crane is a plus for a Concrete Worker, but not required.

Help drivers get back on the road quickly and safely.

About the role: As a Telephone Roadside Assistance Agent, you are the first point of contact for drivers who experience a breakdown while on the road. You remain calm, ask the right questions, and make sure every driver receives the support they need. You coordinate interventions with partner services and keep the driver informed throughout the process. It's a role with real impact: thanks to your composure, communication skills, and problem-solving mindset, you make a genuine difference during stressful moments. Your responsibilities: 

 
•  
 Answer incoming calls from drivers experiencing vehicle breakdowns. 

 
• Assess the situation by asking targeted questions and gathering essential information. 
 
•  
Organise interventions and dispatch assistance to towing services, partners, or technicians. 

 
•  
Follow up each case from start to finish, ensuring clear and proactive communication with the driver. 

 
•  
Record all relevant data in the system (time, location, issue details, planning, updates...). 

 
• Stay calm in urgent situations and consistently act with customer focus. 
 
• Working together in a dedicated team: You will be part of a team that is committed 24/7 to providing our customers with the best possible support.

 

What we expect from you : 

 
• Strong communication skills and the ability to speak clearly, empathetically, and professionally over the phone. 
 

 
• Stress resilience and the ability to maintain oversight in busy situations. 
 
•  
A natural talent for problem-solving. 

 
•  
Confidence in working with digital tools and administrative follow-up. 

 
• Willingness to work in a shift system: early, late, day, night and weekend work. 
 
• Experience in dispatching, customer service, or roadside assistance is an asset. 
 
•  
Fluent in English, Czech & another Eastern language (minimum B2 level).

 Civil Engineer-Architect for our Technical Office based in 
Ternat.
 

Are you a recent industrial science/architecture grad? Eager to innovate and design? Keep on reading!
 

Main responsibilities:

Own projects from design to execution, crafting custom solutions.

At Leviat Belgium we are currently looking for an ambitious and enthusiastic 
Project & Process Engineer to join our Operation team based in Ternat, Belgium 
 

Purpose of the position
 

Directing and defining the Continuous Improvement (CI) program within the sites in Belgium. This includes mapping, developing, and optimizing processes, as well as steering and determining operational projects in Belgium.
 

Key Tasks & Responsibilities
 

Strategic: 
 
 

• Develop and implement the CI program in consultation with various managers within the site. 

• Follow up on projects from start to finish  

Operational:
 
 

• Manage multiple projects: Lead both large and small projects from start to finish in operations. 

• Own projects from design to execution, crafting custom solutions. 

• Provide expert insights: Analyze and offer optimal designs that exceed client needs. 

• Engage with stakeholders, management, and contractors to ensure project success. 

• Collaborate with colleagues and the wider operation teams to ensure project success. 

• Develop, layout, and optimize industrial processes. 

• Collect and analyze data. 

• Design, test, and implement new or improved processes. 

• Together with the internal team, build stability and productivity on critical machines. 

• Support CI projects and Kaizen initiatives in the workplace. 

• Implement best practices from other CRH sites. 

• Help the site transition to Industry 4.0. 

• Supporting automation projects  

Staff:
 
 

• Supervise operational projects from start to finish and implement them together with the site team.  
 

• Responsible for training related to Kaizen, VSM, and CI projects. 

• Supervise CI projects from start to finish and implement them together with the site team.  

 
 

Key functional competencies
 
 

• Education: Engineering education. 

• Experience: Process improvements, Lean tools, project management. 

• ICT Knowledge: ERP knowledge, drawing packages, programming tools for robots, Power BI. 

• Languages: Dutch, French, English. 

• Other: Analytical skills, technical insight, and the ability to work with deadlines are a must.  

Leviat is an equal opportunities employer. We are commited to creating an inclusive work environment for all employees and actively encourage applications from all sectors of the community.
 

Please note that we cannot accept any applications submitted through email for GDPR purposes. Candidates must apply through our job portal. We do not accept candidate introductions for this position from recruitment agencies, unless you have been instructed to do so by our recruitment team.

What we offer?
 
 

• We are a global business, looking to attract and retain the best talent 

• A culture that values opportunity for growth, development and internal promotion 

• Highly competitive base pay 

• Pension contribution 

• Hybrid and flexible working dependent on your role 

• A range of other benefits, specific to your role and depending on where in the world you join us i.e. health care, medical insurance, discounted shopping 

• Ongoing personal learning and development support

For our client, a global leader in roll-on/roll-off cargo handling and storage, we are looking for a motivated Pre-Delivery Inspection Operator.

As a Pre-Delivery Inspection Operator, you ensure that every vehicle leaves the premises in top condition. You carry out inspections, prepare vehicles for delivery and make sure any defects or damage are identified and reported correctly.

Preparation and inspection

 
• 
You drive the vehicles through the car wash.

 
• 
You check that all functions are working properly, including the radio and battery.

 
• 
You inspect the tires.

 
• 
You carry out a thorough inspection to identify any damage.

 
• 
You mark any detected damage for the repair department.

Finishing and preparing for delivery

 
• 
You check and confirm the license plates.

 
• 
You equip the vehicles with a fire extinguisher, warning triangle and manuals.

 
• 
You vacuum and clean the vehicle interiors.

Other tasks

 
• 
You move vehicles to the correct zones on the premises.

 
• 
You report defects or deviations to the responsible person in a timely manner.

 
• 
You upload software updates.

What we expect from you

 
• 
You speak Dutch and/or English well enough to communicate fluently with your colleagues.

 
• 
You have a valid driving license and can drive both manual and automatic vehicles.

 
• 
You have the technical insight needed to identify and assess damage.

Welcome to Traxial: Where big ideas start small (but mighty)
 

At Traxial, we don't just design solutions—we engineer the future with bold ideas and a hands-on approach. Our mission is to rethink what's possible in engineering and R&D. Though our team is small, our ambitions are anything but. We move fast, think big, and are driven by curiosity and a shared passion for innovation.
 

About the role
 

Join our R&D team as a Mechanical Design Engineer , where you'll contribute to the development of cutting-edge axial flux motors. 
 

This is what you'll do: 
 
 

•  

Design innovative solutions for new product challenges. 
   
 

•  

Create detailed 3D CAD models and 2D drawings following industry standards. 
   
 

•  

Coordinate with suppliers and subcontractors on design and specifications. 
  

Who are we looking for? 
 
 

•  

Master's degree in Mechanical or Electro-Mechanical Engineering, or equivalent experience. 
   
 

•  

At least 3 years of professional experience in mechanical design and development. 
   
 

•  

Proficient in Siemens NX, Teamcenter PDM or similar CAD/PDM tools. 
   
 

•  

Skilled in DFMEA, DFM, DFA, and geometric dimensioning and tolerancing. 
   
 

•  

Knowledgeable about material properties (metals and plastics), production techniques, and problem-solving methodologies. 
   
 

•  

Strong analytical skills to perform mechanical calculation (eg: reaction forces, bolt sizing, bearing selection).
   
 

•  

This position requires existing work authorization in Belgium.
   
 

•  

A team player with a can-do mentality, creative mindset, and fluent in English.

Traxx is looking for a Mechanical and Thermal Simulations Engineer to join our rapidly growing team. You will be responsible for the structural and mechanical simulation of our axial flux motors and their components, while supporting the development and validation of thermal models for our motors and inverters. 
 

This is what you'll do:
 
 

•  

Strengthen the Simulation Team by improving our structural and mechanical simulation capabilities. 
   
 

•  

Perform structural FEA simulations to evaluate strength, stiffness, fatigue, vibration, and thermal-mechanical behavior of motor components.
   
 

•  

Support the development and validation of thermal simulation models for axial flux motors and power electronics.
   
 

•  

Develop analytical models to complement simulation results and support design decisions.
   
 

•  

Design tests and prototypes required to validate analyses, and correlate simulation results with experimental data.
   
 

•  

Perform root cause analyzes of product and process issues and provide simulation driven recommendations for design improvements.
  

Who are we looking for?
 
 

•  

Master's degree in Electrical or Electronic Engineering, or equivalent experience.
   
 

•  

Deep understanding of electromagnetism and at least 2 years of hands-on experience with electromagnetic simulations.
   
 

•  

Basic understanding of different engineering domains: mechanics, NVH, thermodynamics, ...
   
 

•  

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
   
 

•  

Proficiency in Ansys Maxwell, Jmag, Altair or similar as well as Python
  

•  

Strong English communication skills (both written and verbal), good collaboration skills, and the ability to work effectively across teams within the organizations.

Traxial is looking for an experienced Electromagnetic Simulations Engineer to join our rapidly growing team. You will be taking responsibility for the electromagnetic simulations of our axial flux motors and inverters.
 

This is what you'll do: 
 
 

•  

Develop and implement electromagnetic simulations for our axial flux motors and inverters.
   
 

•  

Analyze simulation results to determine performance characteristics and identify areas for improvement.
   
 

•  

Continually improve our simulation methodologies to reduce development times and improve the accuracy of the test data correlation.
   
 

•  

Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including simulations, and mechanical and prototyping engineers, to optimize the motor design.
   
 

•  

Stay up to date with the latest industry developments and advancements in simulation tools and techniques.
  

•  

Draw conclusions on the root cause analysis of products and processes.
  

Who are we looking for?
 
 

•  

Master's degree in Electrical or Electronic Engineering, or equivalent experience.
   
 

•  

Deep understanding of electromagnetism and at least 2 years of hands-on experience with electromagnetic simulations.
   
 

•  

Basic understanding of different engineering domains: mechanics, NVH, thermodynamics, ...
   
 

•  

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
   
 

•  

Proficiency in Ansys Maxwell, Jmag, Altair or similar as well as Python
  

•  

Strong English communication skills (both written and verbal), good collaboration skills, and the ability to work effectively across teams within the organizations.

For our client in Zeebrugge, a global leader in roll-on/roll-off cargo handling and storage, we are looking for motivated Under Body Coating Workers.

Are you looking for a stable job with a competitive salary in a modern working environment? As an Under Body Coating Worker, you will help protect new cars from rust and contribute to the quality of the finished vehicle.

As an Under Body Coating Worker, you are responsible for preparing new cars and applying protective coatings to the underbody. You work accurately according to clear work instructions and quality standards.

 
• 
You prepare new cars for rust protection, with a focus on the underbody.

 
• 
You apply protective wax coatings using a specialised spray gun.

 
• 
You perform quality checks and make sure the work is carried out according to the provided work instructions.

 
• 
You contribute to a high-quality and well-organised working environment.

What we expect from you:

 
• 
You are hands-on, detail-oriented and eager to learn new skills

 
• 
You are a real team player with a positive attitude

 
• 
You are flexible and available to work in shifts

 
• 
You have a good knowledge of English

Our client, located in the Beveren region, is looking for a Supervisor Piping & Mechanical with strong technical expertise and people leadership skills.
 
 

• You’ll lead, coordinate and supervise daily piping and mechanical maintenance activities with a strong focus on HSE, quality, cost control and operational continuity 

• You’ll plan, prioritize and allocate maintenance work to ensure efficient execution of both preventive and corrective maintenance activities 

• You’ll organize daily toolbox meetings, communicate priorities and ensure compliance with all safety procedures and permit-to-work requirements 

• You’ll actively supervise field activities and provide technical support to technicians and contractors during the execution of maintenance work 

• You’ll coordinate closely with Operations, Engineering, Reliability and Inspection departments to align maintenance priorities and ensure efficient plant availability 

• You’ll ensure the safe and efficient execution of maintenance activities on piping systems, pressure vessels, heat exchangers, storage tanks and other static equipment 

• You’ll safeguard the mechanical integrity of plant assets by ensuring that maintenance and repair activities are executed according to engineering standards, site procedures and applicable regulations 

• You’ll support inspection programs and follow up on findings, integrity assessments, statutory inspections and corrective actions 

• You’ll coordinate and manage external contractors, ensuring compliance with safety, quality, planning and budget requirements 

• You’ll monitor work quality and verify that repairs, modifications and installations are completed according to specifications and industry standards 

• You’ll support the preparation, execution and evaluation of shutdowns, turnarounds and maintenance projects 

• You’ll drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on reliability, safety, efficiency and maintenance performance 

• You’ll ensure accurate maintenance administration and reporting in SAP, including work order completion, time registration and maintenance history 
 

• You have a Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or a comparable technical qualification, or equivalent by experience 

• You have at least 5 years of relevant maintenance experience within the petrochemical, chemical, oil & gas or related process industry 

• You’re experienced in a supervisory, team leader or coordination role within an industrial environment 

• You have solid knowledge of piping systems, pressure equipment, heat exchangers, storage tanks and other static equipment 

• You have a good understanding of mechanical integrity principles, inspection methodologies and reliability-driven maintenance practices 

• You have a strong knowledge of HSE requirements, permit-to-work systems, contractor management and process safety 

• You’re experienced with SAP or another CMMS system and good proficiency in Microsoft Office applications 

• You own strong planning, organizational and problem-solving skills, with the ability to effectively manage changing priorities 

• You have excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, enabling effective collaboration across multiple disciplines 

• You are fluent in Dutch and have a good command of English 

• You have a hands-on leadership style with the ability to motivate, coach and develop people

This vacancy is exclusively intended for direct candidates. Selection, interim, and recruitment agencies are kindly requested to refrain from contacting us.
 

Boury is a three-Michelin-starred restaurant with international recognition for its precision, refinement, and uncompromising quality standards. Our kitchen operates at the highest level of contemporary gastronomy, where craftsmanship, discipline, and perfection are at the heart of everything we do.
 

We are looking for an experienced, structured, and creative baker. In this role, you will be responsible for the daily production of bread and bakery products at the highest gastronomic level. You will work closely with the kitchen team to ensure consistency, quality, and flawless execution, directly contributing to the overall guest experience.
 

Your responsibilities include:
 
 

• Preparing and baking artisan breads and bakery products according to Boury’s quality standards; 

• Managing the daily mise en place and production planning for bakery products; 

• Contributing to a professional, disciplined, and team-oriented working environment; 

• Continuously striving for improvement in techniques, efficiency, and quality. 
 

• You have at least 2 years of relevant professional experience within a high-quality bakery or gastronomic environment. 

• You have a genuine passion and interest in products, craftsmanship, and the continuous pursuit of excellence. 

• You are motivated to work at the highest gastronomic level and have an eye for detail, consistency, and quality. 

• You are comfortable working during weekends and understand the commitment required within a top-level culinary environment. 

• Due to the international nature of our team, you are able to communicate effectively in English. Knowledge of Dutch is considered a plus. 

• You are a team-oriented professional with a positive attitude, strong work ethic, and a willingness to continuously improve your techniques and contribute to the team.

Remote Work: Hybrid, 2 days onsite per week in Brugge
Start Date: ASAP / 22/06/2026
End Date: 31/12/2026, renewable
Language Requirement: Dutch and English
Azure Cloud Engineering

• Strong knowledge of the Software Development Lifecycle.
• Experience implementing best practices for scalability, high availability, and cost optimization.

Talencia is looking for an Angular/Node.js Developer (Medior/Senior) for one of its clients.

Location: Brussels – Hybrid (2 days onsite/week)
Duration: 6 months
Start: ASAP
 
About the role
We are looking for a Medior/Senior Angular / Node.js Developer to join an existing Agile development team working on web applications related to insurance policy management.

The developer will contribute to the development, maintenance, testing and improvement of both front-end and back-end applications.
Responsibilities
• Develop and maintain applications using Angular and Node.js.
• Design and implement new features and technical improvements.
• Participate in unit and end-to-end testing.
• Ensure code quality, maintainability and proper test coverage.
• Participate in code reviews, refactoring and continuous improvement.
• Collaborate with developers, business stakeholders and technical teams.
• Work within an Agile/Scrum/Kanban environment
Mandatory skills
• Strong hands-on experience with Angular.
• Strong hands-on experience with Node.js.
• Experience as a Medior/Senior Full Stack Developer.
• Experience with automated testing.
• Good understanding of Agile methodologies.
• Fluent French or Dutch and English
• Good communication and problem-solving skills.Nice to have
• NestJS
• Jest / Playwright / Cypress
• SonarQube
• GitLab / GitLab CI/CD
• Docker
• Experience with refactoring, code coverage and CI/CD pipelines.
• Previous experience in the insurance sector is a plus.

As a Business Manager Data & AI, you will :

• Be a part of our sales team and reporting directly to the Managing Director Benelux
• Act as a true entrepreneur by managing your own profit centre
• Lead a business unit composed of multiple clients and consultants, driving the development and long-term success of your agency (both existing accounts and new business).
Your key responsibilities will include:

• Business Development: Creating, developing, and securing long-term business relationships with key clients and strategic partners.
• Tailored Solutions: Analysing client needs across various engagement models, including technical assistance, service centres, and project-based delivery.
• Commercial Proposals: Collaborating closely with internal technical teams to design high-value solutions and prepare winning commercial proposals.
• Team Management & Recruitment: Recruiting your own team of consultants and actively managing their careers (project follow-ups, performance reviews, and coordination with HR).
• Financial Management: Ensuring strong financial performance, monitoring margins, and driving the profitability of your business unit.
• Market Strategy: Anticipating market trends, monitoring the competitive landscape, and shaping strategic growth to keep us ahead of the curve.
Our ambition is to provide you with all the tools you need to succeed and unlock rapid career progression. Over time, depending on your performance, you will have access to higher-responsibility roles, allowing you to shape your own strategy and contribute directly to our international growth.
 
To succeed in this role, you have:

• A Master's degree from an Engineering School, Business School, or an equivalent university degree combined with relevant experience.
• An excellent command of both English and Dutch (mandatory for this role to effectively cover the Benelux market).
• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, curiousity, a solution-oriented mindset, and strong team spirit.
• A strong entrepreneurial mindset. Driven, resilient, and ambitious, you thrive on challenges and want to grow in a fast-paced, high-performance environment. 
• Our own Academy: Hone your craft with continuous training and certifications in the latest cutting-edge technologies.
• Tailored Career Growth: Benefit from hands-on management, regular follow-ups, and a personalised roadmap designed to elevate your career to the next level.
• A Vibrant Community: Dive into our technical hubs to exchange best practices, find a mentor, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the field.
• Award-Winning Culture: We are officially certified as a Great Place To Work®, a badge we wear with pride.
• Work Hard, Play Hard: From unforgettable seminars to legendary office parties, we ensure there's plenty of room for fun.
Flexibility & Mobility

Whether you're looking to move across the country or across borders, we support your life goals through our national and international mobility programmes.

Diversity & Inclusion

At our company, diversity isn't just a buzzword - it's who we are. We are dedicated to fostering an inclusive environment where equal opportunities are the standard, not the exception. All our positions are open to people with disabilities.
